headline.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Early Bird ticket savings end in 3 days
headline.summary: Early Bird ticket sales for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 will end in three days, with potential savings of up to $410. The deadline for discounted pricing is May 29 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

articles.title: In more good news for Amazon, Snowflake signs $6B deal with AWS for AI CPU chips
articles.summary: Snowflake has entered into a five-year, $6 billion agreement with Amazon Web Services to procure AI CPU chips. This deal highlights the growing competition in the AI hardware market, particularly for Nvidia.

articles.title: Payroll startup Remote says it grew revenue 50% per employee without adding headcount
articles.summary: Payroll startup Remote has achieved over $300 million in annual recurring revenue and reached cash-flow positivity, driven by a 50% increase in revenue per employee through the adoption of AI technologies. The company accomplished this growth without increasing its headcount.

articles.title: Websites have a new way to spy on visitors: analyzing their SSD activity
articles.summary: Websites can now track visitors by analyzing their solid-state drive (SSD) activity through JavaScript executed in the browser. This method allows for the collection of data based on the unique patterns of SSD usage.

articles.title: ITBench-AA: Frontier Models Score Below 50% on the First Benchmark for Agentic Enterprise IT Tasks — by Artificial Analysis and IBM
articles.summary: The ITBench-AA benchmark reveals that frontier AI models score below 50% on tasks related to agentic enterprise IT, indicating significant challenges in their performance for practical applications in this domain. This assessment was conducted by Artificial Analysis in collaboration with IBM.

articles.title: Your SEO strategy is optimized for a search engine that no longer exists.
articles.summary: Google I/O has confirmed that AI-generated answers will now dominate search results, significantly altering the landscape for SEO strategies that have relied on traditional link-based visibility. Brands face challenges in understanding how AI describes them to customers, marking a major shift in digital marketing practices.

articles.title: AI coding startup Cognition raises $1B at $25B pre-money valuation
articles.summary: AI coding startup Cognition has raised $1 billion at a pre-money valuation of $25 billion, following a significant increase in its annualized revenue run rate to $492 million. The company has more than doubled its valuation in just eight months.

articles.title: Meta launches Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp subscriptions, with more to come, including AI plans
articles.summary: Meta has introduced paid subscription plans for Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp globally, with additional AI and creator-focused services in development under the "Meta One" brand. The company aims to enhance user experiences and monetization options across its platforms.

articles.title: Startup Battlefield 200 applications close today: Nominate a founder or submit your startup
articles.summary: Today marks the final deadline for applications and nominations for Startup Battlefield 200, which offers startups the opportunity to compete for $100,000 in equity-free funding and gain visibility at TechCrunch Disrupt. Submissions must be completed by 11:59 p.m. PT to be considered.

articles.title: SOND, a sleep tech startup from Bose’s former head of sleep, exits stealth with $7M
articles.summary: SOND, a sleep technology startup founded by Bose's former head of sleep, has emerged from stealth mode with $7 million in funding. The company launched its first product, Dreambuds, an in-ear system designed to monitor and respond to 12 physiological signals to enhance sleep quality.

articles.title: Huawei's ‘Chip Queen’ Throws Down the Gauntlet
articles.summary: Huawei is adapting its chip production strategies in response to the limitations of Moore's Law, which may challenge the current dominance of US chip manufacturers. The company's efforts could reshape the competitive landscape in the semiconductor industry.

articles.title: Full automation of AI R&D probably yields a large speed up even without a software-only singularity
articles.summary: A recent analysis suggests that the full automation of AI research and development could significantly accelerate progress in the field, even without reaching a "software-only singularity." The study indicates that this automation may lead to improvements in algorithms at a rate that surpasses current expectations, potentially yielding substantial advancements in a shorter timeframe.
